title: 第14章 我选陆阳当班副，谁敢反对？
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “简简单单开个班务会，把有些事落实一下。”“我准备让陆阳当咱们班副班长，谁赞成，谁反对？”周末清晨，新兵们被破天荒的允许多睡半小时。起来后依旧是雷打不动的叠被，洗漱，早操，吃早饭。但值得庆幸的是，周末不搞体能，还能给大家半天的放松时间。之后的班务会上，周凯东目光象征性的扫过班上新兵，征询大家意见。但当看到丁腾飞屁股似乎有点儿坐不住时，他眉头微皱再度开口。“如果班上有人内务比陆阳做得好，三公里能跑进全排前几，能帮连里出黑板报的，也可以站起来毛遂自荐。”“......”丁腾飞的屁股忽然就变得安分许多。周凯东心里冷笑，还算这小子有点儿自知之明。就在这时，三排长通知他去连部开会，于是周凯东只能草草的提前结束班务会。临走前，他着重强调：“条令条例还没背熟的，给我抓点儿紧，我不在时候陆阳负责班级纪律。”“是。”“你先跟我出来一趟。”陆阳跟着班长离开了，不知道干什么去？但周凯东前脚刚走，后脚班上就闹腾起来。十八九岁正是爱玩儿的年纪，来部队这么些天了，每天都是训练，内务，和思想教育，过得一直很压抑，今儿还是头回过周末，自然得稍微撒撒欢儿。丁腾飞把马扎收起，一屁股坐到陆阳床上，丝毫不顾及是不是把他床单给弄皱了。他冲着对面大眼瞪小眼，把条令条例翻的哗啦啦响的孔垄，阴阳怪气的说道：“哎，刚才选班副，你怎么不站起来？我还想选你来着呢，选你都比选那傻逼好。”孔垄抬头瞪他一眼：“你特么天天跟谁俩呢，嘴巴放干净点！”丁腾飞没好气的说：“我又没说你，你着什么急？”随后，他冲着班上其他人说道：“不是，难道这个班，就我看陆阳不爽？成天装的跟特么什么一样，有点机会就表现，哈哈，哈哈哈......”完全没人搭理，他只能是尴尬的笑笑，然后继续自言自语。这些天相处下来，丁腾飞是什么秉性，他们已经很了解了。自已不努力不上进，还不许别人刻苦，典型的小肚鸡肠。但凡有人在训练里被表扬，回来了他都得阴阳怪气两句。说什么，这么努力有什么用，这个社会有钱才是王道，当兵都是没出息的人。是的，这家伙经常连自已的一块儿骂，典型的左右脑互搏；所以大伙儿根本就懒得搭理，更不想和他争辩什么。反倒是孔垄这个直脾气，把东西往床上一丢，气势汹汹的站起身推了他一把。“你特么有什么资格看人家陆阳不爽，连个三公里都跑不过人家，还特么全班垫底，好意思的？”“草，我，我那是起猛了，跑岔气了！”“菜，就多练，少特么逼逼叨叨的。最烦你这种人，还特么跑去跟指导员打班长小报告，跟个脑残似的，活该你天天被叼！”“你放屁！”丁腾飞气急败坏，矢口否认。他前两天确实偷偷举报了班长在宿舍里抽烟的事儿。当时指导员告诉他一定会严肃处理，严格保密，怎么转头就让人知道了？“真尼玛山炮！”孔垄都被他逗笑了：“就这还在外头混的，你混个der啊！”“小孩子都知道不能随便打小报告，你还跑去跟指导员告班长的状，脑残？”丁腾飞气急败坏的狡辩，但内心已经认定了，肯定是从陆阳嘴里传出来的！就陆阳和指导员走得近，肯定是出黑板报的时候，指导员无意间提起，然后就被这家伙知道了！草他奶奶的，还真是他娘的老乡见老乡，背后开两枪！这狗日的，居然玩儿背刺？就在这时，陆阳提溜着一个黑色塑料袋，兴高采烈的从外头回来。“讲一下，今天过周末，班长特批大家玩手机。”“卧槽！”所有人瞬间沸腾了，全都朝着陆阳围上去，像极了嗷嗷待哺的孩子。陆阳就差被这帮人给拱翻了，赶忙将袋子打开，将手机分发给大家。“班长说了，没手机的可以用他的往家里打个电话，长途电话费他出。”“哎哟我去，班长人这么好的嘛？”“那长途费可不便宜，咱要是拿他手机煲电话粥，他这个月得破产吧！”“班副，让我先打，让我先打，我家最远！”陆阳将班长手机，给到那个家最远的兵。看着他拿着手机，迫不及待的走到窗边拨通家里电话。眼神里那股子激动，喜悦，想家的劲儿，根本藏不住。最后一部手机，是一部摩托摩拉最新款，瞧着就不便宜。但没等陆阳去看背盖后贴的名字，就被人一把夺走。见到丁腾飞怒视自已的眼神，陆阳很是不解：“这家伙又抽什么风？”孔垄凑到他耳边，把先前发生的事，简单讲了一遍。听到对方误以为，是自已当的大喇叭，陆阳也是一脸的无语。在部队里，找指导员打自已班长的小报告，是禁忌中的禁忌，尤其还是这些无关紧要的小事。这就等同于，学生跑去教务处告自已班主任的状，说他在批改试卷的时候抠脚丫子。原本，他以为丁腾飞只是单纯的好不起来，没想到他蠢还蠢的这么彻底？他难道难道不知道，老兵和老兵都是一伙儿的，消息都是互通的吗？陆阳懒得去解释，跟他本就说不着什么，更没有那个必要。“孔垄，你不给家里打个电话？”陆阳见孔垄拿到手机的第一时间，就是听歌刷小说，于是好奇问了句。孔垄嘿嘿笑着：“我高中三年一直住校，我爸妈都习惯了我不在家，一会再打也没事。”陆阳很是好奇：“高中一直住校，你这身腱子肉，咋练的？”尽管入伍这么些天，孔垄的肌肉已经缩水一圈，但因为块头在那儿，所以看着还是比一般人壮实的多。孔垄嘿嘿一笑：“我寒暑假去健身房打工，分哔不花还能免费锻炼，你就说带派不带派吧老铁！”“有头脑！你看的啥小说？”“邻家有女....”“老柳写的？”“哎呀卧槽，你也看过？”陆阳建议：“换一本吧，太监了。去看校花的贴身...估计你退伍了，书还在更着呢。”孔垄被唬的一愣一愣，双手抱拳拱手：“不愧是读书人，够专业，回头闹书荒了来找你嗷！”前世，陆阳就是网文看的太多，导致成绩下滑严重。所以这一世，他是能不碰坚决不碰，因为这玩意儿瘾是真的大。但如果别人想看，他还是会分文别类的去推荐各种题材的优质好书，这玩意儿能拽一个入坑就拽一个。来到走廊上，陆阳从通讯录里找出家里座机电话，刚按下拨号键，听筒里边传来一阵熟悉的葫芦丝旋律。这首《月光下的凤尾竹》曲调轻快，裹挟着时代感扑面而来，也让他莫名心安。电话响了没一会就被接听，紧跟着听筒里便传来了母亲的声音。“喂......儿子？”“妈。”明明分开还不到半个月，可再度听到母亲的声音，却还是让陆阳有种说不出的情绪。那似乎，叫做乡愁。
content_en: "Just hold a class meeting to implement some things." "I'm going to let Lu Yang be the deputy squad leader of our class. Who is in favor and who is against it?" On weekend mornings, the recruits were allowed to sleep an extra half hour for the first time.After getting up, I still lay down my quilt, wash up, do morning exercises, and have breakfast.But thankfully, not doing physical exercise on the weekend can still give everyone half a day to relax.At the subsequent class meeting, Zhou Kaidong glanced at the new recruits in the class symbolically and asked for everyone's opinions.But when he saw that Ding Tengfei's butt seemed a little unable to sit still, he frowned slightly and spoke again."If there is someone in the class who is better at housekeeping than Lu Yang, who can run three kilometers to the top of the platoon, and who can help the company with the blackboard report, he can stand up and recommend himself." "..." Ding Tengfei suddenly became calmer.Zhou Kaidong sneered in his heart, thinking that this kid was somewhat self-aware.At this moment, the third platoon leader informed him to go to the company headquarters for a meeting, so Zhou Kaidong could only hastily end the squad meeting early.Before leaving, he emphasized: "If you haven't memorized the rules and regulations yet, hold on tight. Lu Yang will be responsible for class discipline when I'm not around." "Yes." "You come out with me first." Lu Yang left with the squad leader. He didn't know what he was going to do.But as soon as Zhou Kaidong left, the class started to make a fuss.The age of eighteen or nineteen is a fun-loving age. I have been in the army for so many days, and every day is filled with training, internal affairs, and ideological education. My life has always been very depressing. Today, it is the first time to have a weekend, so naturally I have to have a little fun.Ding Tengfei put away the mazza and sat down on Lu Yang's bed, not caring whether his sheets were wrinkled.He glared at Kong Rong, who was opposite him and turned over the rules and regulations, and said angrily: "Hey, why didn't you stand up when I was choosing the class deputy just now? I still want to choose you. It's better to choose you than that idiot." Kong Long raised his head and glared at him: "Who are you talking to every day? Keep your mouth clean!" Ding Tengfei was annoyed!He said: "I didn't tell you, why are you so anxious?" Then he said to the other people in the class: "No, am I the only one in this class who is unhappy with Lu Yang? He pretends to be the same all the time, and acts when he gets the chance, haha, hahaha..." No one paid any attention to him, and he could only smile awkwardly, and then continued talking to himself.After getting along with him these days, they already have a good understanding of Ding Tengfei's nature.If you don't work hard, you won't make progress, and you won't allow others to work hard. You are a typical little chicken.Whenever someone is praised in training, he will make some weird remarks when he comes back.What can I say? What's the use of working so hard? Money is king in this society, and soldiers are all useless people.Yes, this guy often scolds himself, a typical left-brain battle; so everyone is too lazy to pay attention to him, let alone argue with him.On the contrary, Kong Long was so outspoken that he threw the things on the bed, stood up angrily and pushed him."What qualifications do you have to see Lu Yang unhappy? He can't even run a three-kilometer run, and he's at the bottom of the class. Are you embarrassed?" "Damn it, I, I just got too strong and ran away!" "You just need to practice more," he said., You are such a nagging person.What bothers you the most is that you go to report to the class leader like a fool.You deserve to be bitten every day!" Ding Tengfei was furious and denied it.He did secretly report the squad leader smoking in the dormitory two days ago.At that time, the instructor told him that he would be dealt with seriously and kept strictly confidential. How could he turn around and let people know?"What an idiot!" Kong Rong was amused by him: "You're just hanging around outside, you're a dick!" "Children know not to make casual reports, but you still go to the instructor to report the situation to the class monitor, are you stupid?" Ding Tengfei argued angrily, but he had already confirmed in his heart that it must have come from Lu Yang's mouth!As for Lu Yang getting close to the instructor, it must have been when the instructor accidentally mentioned it during the blackboard announcement, and then this guy found out!To make fun of his grandma, he was really a fellow from the mother-in-law who met a fellow countryman and shot him twice in the back!This bitch is actually trying to stab you in the back?At this moment, Lu Yang came back happily from outside carrying a black plastic bag."Let me tell you, it's the weekend today, and the squad leader specially approved everyone to use their mobile phones." "Fuck!" Everyone was excited instantly, and they all gathered around Lu Yang, like children waiting to be fed.Lu Yang was almost knocked over by this group of people, so he quickly opened the bag and distributed the mobile phones to everyone."The squad leader said that those who don't have a mobile phone can use his to call home, and he will pay for the long-distance calls." "Oh, let me go, why is the squad leader so nice?" "The long-distance charges are not cheap. If we use his mobile phone to make phone calls, he will go bankrupt this month!" "Squad deputy, let me call first, let me call first, my home is the farthest!" Lu Yang gave the squad leader's cell phone to the soldier whose home is farthest.Watching him holding his mobile phone, he couldn't wait to go to the window and dial his home number.The excitement, joy, and homesickness in his eyes couldn't be hidden at all.The last mobile phone is the latest model from Motorola, which doesn’t look cheap.But before Lu Yang could look at the name on the back cover, someone snatched it away.Seeing Ding Tengfei's eyes glaring at him, Lu Yang was puzzled: "Why is this guy so angry?" Kong Long leaned into his ear and briefly told what happened before.Lu Yang was also speechless when he heard that the other party mistakenly thought that he was acting as a loudspeaker.In the army, asking the instructor to make a small report about one's squad leader is a taboo among taboos, especially on these trivial matters.This is equivalent to a student going to the Academic Affairs Office to complain to his or her class teacher, saying that he picked his feet while correcting test papers.Originally, he thought that Ding Tengfei simply couldn't get better, but he didn't expect that he could be so completely stupid?Doesn't he know that veterans and veterans are all in the same group, and they all exchange information?Lu Yang didn't bother to explain. There was nothing to say to him, and there was no need."Kong Long, why don't you call home?" Lu Yang asked curiously when he saw that the first time Kong Long got his phone was to listen to music and read novels.Kong Long chuckled: "I have been living on campus for three years in high school. My parents are used to me not being at home. It's okay to fight after a while." Lu Yang was very curious: "You have been living on campus in high school. How did you develop your tendons?" Even though he had been in the army for so many days, Kong Long's muscles had shrunk, but because of the bulk, he still looked much stronger than the average person.Kong Long chuckled: "I work in the gym during the winter and summer vacations. I can exercise for free without spending any money. Just say it with or without pie, old man!" "You have a brain! What novel are you reading?" "There's a Girl Next Door..." "Written by Lao Liu?" "Oh shit, you've read it too?" Lu Yang suggested: "Change a bookWell, I'm a eunuch.I'm going to see the school belle's bodyguard... I guess you've retired from the army and are still reading." Kong Long was stunned for a moment, and he clasped his hands in his hands and said, "You are indeed a scholar, and I will come to see you when I am in trouble!" In his previous life, Lu Yang read too many online articles, which caused a serious decline in his grades.So in this life, he could not touch it and decided not to touch it, because this thing is really addictive.But if others want to read it, he will still recommend high-quality books on various subjects by category. This thing can drag anyone into the trap.Arriving in the corridor, Lu Yang found his home landline phone number from the address book. As soon as he pressed the dial button, a familiar Hulusi melody came from the receiver.The song "Phoenix Bamboo Under the Moonlight" has a brisk melody, which carries a sense of the times and makes him feel at ease inexplicably.The phone was answered shortly after it rang, and my mother's voice came from the receiver."Hello... son?" "Mom." Although they had been separated for less than half a month, Lu Yang still felt an indescribable emotion when he heard his mother's voice again.That seems to be called nostalgia.
